profile.headline: Fintorian (noun) /fin-tôr-ē-ən/ - nerd, entrepreneur, story teller, and techonomist
profile.summary: Innovative technology leader whose mission it is to bring together global communities around business, finance, and technology.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Architect, design, and develop complex systems at scale and posses expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise systems architecture, and engineering best practices.

Responsible for driving on-premise and overall Cloud technical architecture and amplify impact by aligning organizations toward coherent architectural strategies.

Actively mentor individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designs and develops auto telematics software solutions to meet requirements from a variety of customers across various business verticals to deliver global driver safety.

Operationalizes machine learning algorithms and analytic solutions to provide actionable insights on driver behavior and vehicle dynamics to auto insurers, vehicle fleets, auto-makers, and other markets.

Utilizes DevOps and Cloud technology to support continuous delivery to meet changing customer and business needs in a fast paced environment.

positions.title: Sales Engineer
positions.description:
Expert in usage based insurance (UBI), smartphone telematics, data analytics, and risk modeling.

Built and delivered mobile, IoT, and cloud-based solutions for products and services in order to serve existing and prospective mobile telematics customers.

Collaborated with customers, engineers, and sales teams in order to assess mobile telematics software and/or hardware business needs to determine system requirements.

positions.title: Hadoop Developer
positions.description:
Develop distributed applications and algorithms for parallel processing of petabyte sized data on Cloudera and Hortonworks Hadoop distributions and commoditized virtual machines (VM’s)

Develop Object-Oriented and Functional Programming software using Map/Reduce, Spark, and ETL applications

Expose Analytics as a Service RESTful API’s for application integration and data consumption

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and tested the creation and/or maintenance of web based applications

Influenced and offered feedback to business and systems partners to enhance the vision for web based software development, integration, and support

Led and/or contributed strategic work (crosses multiple organizational boundaries) and influenced the direction set for teams, procedures, and processes
